snippet.title: What the Buck?! - Official Release Date Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Watch the Release Date Announcement Trailer for What the Buck?!, an incremental game about destroying money developed by kohlgames. Swipe the credit card, shred stacks of cash and set off chain reactions with electric, explosive and golden bills. End your shift, spend Prestige Points on permanent upgrades and cash out stock certificates at the right moment. What the Buck?! launches on November 9, 2026 on Steam for Windows, macOS and Linux. Play the free demo now, also during Steam Next Fest from October 19 to 26.

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4832970/What_the_Buck/
Discord: https://discord.gg/rAAuDMRU2g
